images.note: Lectures 1-4 only. Lecture 1: 16 of the deck's 45 pages, every figure-bearing slide except staff photographs, a meme, clip-art icons, a logo wall, and slides whose only images are equations transcribed exactly. Lecture 2: 15 of 27 pages, every figure-bearing slide except two SpongeBob cartoon stills credited to Viacom International. Lecture 3: 11 of 28 pages, every figure-bearing slide except a repeat of slide 5, three equation slides whose only picture is a thumbnail of slide 12's humanoid, and slides whose only images are pasted equations transcribed exactly. Lecture 4: 21 of 37 pages, every figure-bearing slide except three build steps (11, 15, 26) whose content the next slide shows, and equation slides whose annotations are transcribed. No other lecture has images.

caveats: Only Lectures 1-4 of 19 are covered; the KB cannot answer questions about the technical content of Lectures 5-19.
Lecture 1's recording leaves out the course-logistics slides (5-6 and 10-15); their content comes from the slides alone.
Lecture 2's recording ends after slide 21; slides 22-27 (collecting demonstrations, the embodiment gap, the summary) come from the slides alone.
Lecture 3's recording does not discuss slide 2's reminders and skips the KL constraint on slide 25 for time; that constraint comes from the slides alone.

Lecture 4's recording ends on the review slide (23); slides 24-37 (off-policy actor-critic, replay buffers, soft actor-critic, the SAC-versus-PPO chart, the closing slides) come from the slides alone, with no spoken explanation.

Transcripts are copy-edited from YouTube auto-captions; students are inaudible, so their questions appear only as the lecturer restates them. Lectures 1 and 2 each have three passages marked [Ed: unclear], Lecture 3 one, Lecture 4 two.
The verbatim captions are not committed; each transcript says how to regenerate them.
